check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点一下打卡。

dialogue.en: Hey Tom, got a minute? I'm stuck on something.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: got a minute 求助万能开场，比 do you have time 更口语

dialogue.en: The Zookeeper cluster keeps losing its leader during the Storm 2 failover test.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: keeps losing 总是在丢，表示反复出现的问题
dialogue.zh: Storm 2 故障转移测试时，Zookeeper 集群总是在丢 leader。

dialogue.en: Hmm, that sounds like a network partition thing. What have you tried so far?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: what have you tried so far 求助前先说自己做过的，对方更愿意帮
dialogue.zh: 嗯，听起来像网络分区。你已经试过什么了？

dialogue.en: I bumped up the timeouts and checked the firewall rules, but it's still flaky.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: flaky 时好时坏的，技术口语高频词；bumped up 调大
dialogue.zh: 我调大了超时时间，也查了防火墙规则，但还是不稳定。

dialogue.en: Did you look at the packet loss between the nodes?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: packet loss 丢包，网络排查关键词
dialogue.zh: 你看过节点之间的丢包吗？

dialogue.en: Not yet, actually. That's a good idea. Could you show me how to check that?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: could you show me how to... 比 tell me 更谦虚，请教的黄金句式
dialogue.zh: 还没，确实是个好思路。你能教我怎么查吗？

dialogue.en: Yeah, happy to. I've got some time after lunch. Want to pair on it?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: pair on it 一起结对看，技术团队高频
dialogue.zh: 当然，我午饭后有时间，要一起 pair 吗？

dialogue.en: That would be amazing. Thanks, I owe you one.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: I owe you one 欠你一个人情，受助后的标准感谢
dialogue.zh: 太好了，谢谢，欠你一个人情。

dialogue.en: No problem. Bring your laptop and we'll dig in.
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: dig in 深入开干，很口语
dialogue.zh: 没问题。带上电脑，我们一起挖。

key_phrases.en: Got a minute? I'm stuck on something.
What have you tried so far? I bumped up the timeouts and checked the firewall rules.
key_phrases.note: 求助时先讲自己做过的，对方更愿意帮
key_phrases.zh: 你试过什么了？我调大了超时时间，也查了防火墙规则。

key_phrases.en: Could you show me how to check that?
key_phrases.note: 请教的具体说法，比 can you help me 更有效
约结对排查的地道说法
key_phrases.zh: 要一起 pair 看看吗？

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS，每句跟读 2 遍，注意求助语气的真诚
背诵 5 分钟：遮住英文，只看中文说出英文
模拟 5 分钟：想一个你真实的 blocker，用英文讲清楚现象、你试过什么、你需要什么帮助
roleplay_zh: 你被一个真实的技术问题卡住了：用英文向同事描述现象、列出你已经试过的两招，然后请他教你一招新的。
scene_zh: 被技术问题卡住时向同事求助，比如 Zookeeper 集群出问题。目标是讲清现象和已尝试的方案，让对方能快速帮上忙。
title: Asking for Help with a Blocker
